Start With this Prayer Everyday:

O St Therese of the Chiki Jesus, who during your short fife on
earth became a mirror of angelic purty, of love strong as death, and of
wholehzarted abandonment to God, now thet you rejoice in the reward
of your virtues, cast a gisnce of pity on me as | leave all things in your
hands. Make my troubles your own, speak = word for me to Our Lady
Immaculate, whose flower of special love you were — to that Queen of
Heaven “who smiled.on you at the dawn of life” Beg her powerhd
intercession the grace | yearn for so ardently at this moment...
(Mention Prayer Request) and that she jom with it a blessing that may
Strengthen me during life, defend me at the hour of death, and lesd me
Straight on to a happy et=maty. Amen. © Ged, who did inflame with the
‘Spirit of Love, the soul of your servant Therese of the Child Jesus,
rant that we also may love you and make you much loved. Amen.

Day1

O Therese of the Child Jesus, well beloved and full of charity, in
union with you, | reverently adore the majesty of God, and since |
rejoice with exceeding joy in the singular gifts of grace bestowed upon
you during your life. and your gifts of glory after death, | give Him
Geenes thanks for them, | beseech you with all my heart's devotion to
be pleased to obtain for me (Mention Request). But if what | ask of you
$0 eamestly does not tend to the glory of God and the grester good of
my soul, do you, | pray, obtain for me that which is more profitable to
both these ends. Amen.

St. Therese of Lieu
Se. Therese of the Child Fesus

St. Therese of the Child Jesus, pray for us.

Day 2

Almighty God, gtver of all good gifts, who did will that Siessed
Therese, being watered by the Neaventy dew of your guiding grace,
should bloom in Carmel with the beauty of virginity end patience in
suffering, grant that | your servant may go forward in the order of her
Swesiness an may be found worthy to become = devoted and loyal
follower of Christ. Amen.

St Therese of the Child Jesus. pray for us

Day 3

O Therese of the Child Jesus, lily of purity, omament and glory of
Carmel, | greet you, great saint. seraph of divine love. | rejoice in the
favors our Lord so liberally bestowed on you. | humility and confidence
| ask you to help me. for | know God has given you love and pity as well
@5 power, Tel Him, now, | beseech you, of the favor | seek in this
navena__ (Mention Request). Your request will crown my petition with
success and bring joy to my heart. Remember your promise to do
good here on earth. “| shall spend my heaven doing good on the Earth
After death | shall iet fall a shower of roses.

St. Therese of the Child Jesus, pray for us.

Day 4

O Little Flower of Jesus, who at an early age had your heart set
on Carmel and in your brief earthly life did become the mirror of
angelic purity, of couregeous love and of whole hearted surrender to
Aimighty God, tum your eyes of mercy upon me who trusts in you_
the grace to keep my heart and mind pure and clean. O Gear saint.
grant me to feel in every need the power of your intercession; help to
comfort me in all the bitemess of this life and especially at its end, that
may be worth to share evemel happiness with you in heaven. Amen.

St. Therese of the Child Jesus. pray for us.

Day5

O Little Flower of Carmel, Almighty God endowed you,
consumed by love for him, with wondrous spiritual strength to follow
the way of perfection during the days of your short jife. Sickness.
touched you early but you remained firm in faith and prayer wes your
life O prey for me that | may benefit by your intercession end be
granted the favor | ask in this novena.__ (Mention Request),

St. Therese of the Child Jesus, pray for us.

Day 6
